summary: A scriptable platform, inspired by norns: instruments called droplets are written in Lua and play sound engines called currents written in Faust, Pd or C. You load them by copying files to the FM-1, which mounts as a USB drive.
features: USB disk mode: copy droplets and currents, no reflashing
15 built-in droplets incl. beat, euclid, life, rack, monk and sophie
rack chains MIDI effects into any voice and two effects
17 Plaits macro-oscillator currents built in, three more as files
midi droplet turns the FM-1 into a USB MIDI controller
276 KB of user disk; browser emulator runs Lua and Faust live
